title: fix(plugin-form): a record dialog with no authored layout opens bounded with a two-column grid (objectui#12521)
body:
Part of #12521
Clause-②: no. Defaults change for a dialog whose author declared no layout. No type, prop, option or export changes: `inferModalSize` keeps its signature and only its mapping moves.

Implemented by the dispatched dev of the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM loop, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`.

## Why `Part of`, and why the card stays open

I measured the card's premise on `origin/main` `521817ce9d` before writing code. It does not hold for the dialog the card measured, HotCRM Leads → New. That dialog **does** have an authored layout, and its 95vw width comes from the console host, not from a `plugin-form` default. This PR does what the card rules for a dialog with **no** authored layout. The measured case needs a decision and a second card, both raised on #12521; details below. Merging this must leave #12521 open.

## What this changes (`@object-ui/plugin-form`, `ModalForm` only)

- **Size.** With no `modalSize`, the dialog took its width from its inferred column count, and three or more columns produced `full` (`sm:max-w-[95vw] sm:w-full`). It now picks `lg` or `xl` from the grid it renders and its field count, and never `full`. The rule is `inferModalSize(min(columns, inferColumns(fieldCount)))`: `inferModalSize` maps one column to `lg` and two or more to `xl`. An authored `modalSize` is used as written, `'full'` included.
- **Grid.** The dialog used to infer one to four columns from its field count whenever nothing declared `columns`. Nothing means not the form and no section. It now lays out at two columns from the container's `@md` tier (`grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-2`), through the same explicit-columns route an authored `columns` takes (`applyAutoLayout` / `applyAutoColSpan`). Every field takes one cell, so fields of one kind share one width. A wide kind (`isWideFieldType`: textarea, rich text, markdown, html, an inline grid) or a `span: 'full'` field takes the row. Three arms take this default:
  - the flat field list;
  - the object's `fieldGroups` fallback;
  - sections that declare no columns.

  A section without `columns` beside sections that declare them keeps the grid's density, unchanged. A two-per-row density cannot be drawn on a three-wide grid; see the second finding below.
- One helper, `sectionedDialogColumns`, now answers "how wide is this dialog's grid" for the stacked layout, the tabbed layout and the derived size. The size is therefore chosen for the grid that actually renders.
- This is dialog-only. `inferColumns` is untouched, so the page form, the drawer, `plugin-detail`'s mirror of it and Studio's `ObjectFormDesigner` are unchanged.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` gains a short paragraph on the dialog's own defaults under "Column width of a sectioned form".

## What this does not change: the card's measured case

1. **The 95vw on HotCRM Leads → New comes from the console host.** `AppContent` spreads `modalSize: 'full'` whenever `deriveRecordFlowSurface(def, 'create' | 'edit').size === 'full'`. That holds for every object with 12 or more authorable fields (`RECORD_SURFACE_PAGE_THRESHOLD` in `@objectstack/spec/data`), and `crm_lead` is one of them. The spec documents the mapping as the protocol default. Its header calls that file "the single source for *how* an object's create / edit / detail record opens by DEFAULT". Its doc says the task flows "map the derived `'page'` to a FULL-SCREEN MODAL", and that `size` "Maps onto `navigation.size` / `FormView.modalSize`". `ModalForm` uses a host-passed `modalSize` as written, so this PR's bound never sees that value. Changing it is a contract question, raised on #12521 as Q1 and not decided here.
2. **The "one column of unequal widths" is HotCRM's authored layout, rendered wrong.** `crm_lead`'s form view authors `sections` with `columns: 2` (contact information) and `columns: 3` (classification), and gives `last_name` `span: 'full'`. The dialog's one grid takes the widest section, which is 3. The `columns: 2` section's fields then get `Math.round(3 / 2)` = 2 cells each, which is one per row at two thirds of the width. A real-`ModalForm` probe measured the classes (the card's widths in brackets):
   - `@md:col-span-2` in a `@2xl:grid-cols-3` grid (841 px);
   - `last_name` at `@md:col-span-2 @2xl:col-span-3` (1270 px);
   - the classification fields at one cell (413 px).

   This is the mixed-density rule in `resolveColSpan`, and every sectioned arm shares it. It is not a no-layout default, and the PM's CONTROL pin keeps authored layouts unchanged, so it is reported on #12521 for its own card.
3. Two pointers in the card body named files that are not on this path:
   - The `size` read in `ObjectView.tsx` is the detail-navigation overlay's, not the create form's.
   - `FormSection.tsx` (`FormSectionContainer`) is imported only by `WizardForm`, not by the dialog.

   Neither file is touched.

### What the landing seat's browser reading should show

- **HotCRM Leads → New at 1440:** unchanged by this PR. The dialog stays `sm:max-w-[95vw]`, and contact information still shows one field per row. It moves only with Q1 and the mixed-density card.
- **A dialog the host does not size**, for example an action-opened create modal on `crm_lead` (`useActionModal` with no `size`): `sm:max-w-[95vw]` before, `sm:max-w-5xl` now. The authored grid classes are unchanged (pinned by the CONTROL case).
- **A console object with no form view and fewer than 12 authorable fields.** At 9 to 11 fields it used to get `full` with three columns. Now it is `xl` with two columns of one width each and a textarea across the row. At 1 to 3 fields it gets `lg` with two columns; it used to be the 512 px default with one column.
- **Below `sm`:** the full-screen sheet with one column, as before.

## Hosts this default reaches (A4)

| Host | Size with no `modalSize`, before → after | Grid |
|---|---|---|
| Console New / Edit (`AppContent`) | 12+ authorable fields: `full` from the host, unchanged. Otherwise `default` / `xl` / `full` → `lg` / `xl` | No layout: inferred 1–4 → 2. Authored: unchanged |
| Action-opened modal (`useActionModal`) | An authored `size` as written; none → `lg` / `xl` | Same rule |
| `ObjectForm` with `formType: 'modal'` | `schema.modalSize` as written; none → `lg` / `xl` | Same rule |
| Designer `ObjectManager` | Authored `lg`, unchanged | Flat custom fields: 2 |
| Studio previews | `form-preview` turns `modal` into a simple form; the in-place backstop draws no dialog | No layout: 2 |
| Screen flows | Do not mount `ModalForm` | none |

## Tests (local, final head `d6ff845dde`)

- New pin file `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/dialogDefaultLayout-12521.test.tsx`, nine cases, all on the real `ModalForm`, form renderer and field registry:
  - twelve fields with no layout → `sm:max-w-5xl`, not 95vw; the grid is `grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-2`; each field is one cell and the textarea is `@md:col-span-2`;
  - a short form → `lg`;
  - below `sm`: base `grid-cols-1`, every multi-column tier `@md:`-prefixed, and the sheet's `h-[100dvh]` / `inset-0` intact;
  - `fieldGroups` and column-less sections get the same default;
  - an authored `modalSize: 'full'` and an authored `columns: 1` are honoured;
  - an authored `span: 'full'` takes the row;
  - **CONTROL:** a HotCRM-shaped `columns: 2` + `columns: 3` layout keeps its grid class and every col-span. Only the size moves, `full` → `xl`.
- `autoLayout.test.ts`: the `inferModalSize` pins now carry the ruled mapping.
- **Ablation.** The old defaults were restored, as the BASE blobs of `ModalForm.tsx` and `autoLayout.ts` (hash-checked on disk), under the new pins. Result: **9 failed, 43 passed**. The two that stayed green are the authored-wins pins (`modalSize: 'full'`, `columns: 1`), which hold under both trees as intended. The CONTROL case failed only at its size line, after its grid and col-span lines had passed on the old tree. That proves the default change leaves authored layout classes byte-identical. The restore was proven by `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- The whole `plugin-form` package plus every create/edit-dialog host test, one locked run, `VERDICT command-exit 0`: **229 files, 2674 passed, 1 skipped**. The host set is what `git grep -l -E "ModalForm|useActionModal|openRecordForm|form=new|createTitle|editTitle|formType: 'modal'|resolveFormViewLayout|deriveRecordFlowSurface"` finds under `packages/app-shell` and `apps/console` tests. Added to it: the designer `ObjectManager` tests, `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`, and the three `packages/types` census files that read `ModalForm`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` exit 0. It runs `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose include `src/**/*.test.tsx` covers the new pin file.
- Gates, exit codes captured before any pipe, all 0:
  - the changeset gates: `check-changeset-presence`, `-no-major`, `-overwrite`, `-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` (0 new);
  - `check:spec-symbols`, `check-doc-links`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-types`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`;
  - `check-test-path-roots` and `check-vi-mock-override-shape`;
  - eslint on the four changed TS files: 0 errors.
- NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI: `check:doc-snippets` stopped at PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2), because its scoped 34-package build was not on disk. The doc edit adds prose only, with no code fence.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx`, "Column width of a sectioned form", says a sectioned form with no `columns` anywhere "is single-column" in every host. `ObjectForm`'s simple path actually falls back to `inferColumns` of its input count, so the sentence was already loose before this PR. Recorded, not filed.
- Two pointers in the card's readings are stale: the `ObjectView.tsx` size read and `FormSection.tsx`. See point 3 above.
